title: Implement the outer layer phase sweep from its actual encoded header with a fixed finite tape program
body:
## Exact scoped result
A 20-tape fixed graph derives the selected outer Gaussian phase sweep directly from the nine-Gamma header, charging each address and cleanup. Independent proof and execution review passed. The central C and common-grid adapter remain outside scope. Credits #5375.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/8b549ca6557ccbb3017b104b27ea35051f990416/research/literal-layer-phase
